006package dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModule;
009import dev.metaschema.databind.IBindingContext;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Performs post-processing on a loaded module.
014 *
015 * @since 2.0.0
016 */
017@FunctionalInterface
018/**
019 * Post-processor interface for module loading operations.
020 * <p>
021 * Implementations can perform additional processing on modules after they have
022 * been loaded, such as applying external constraints.
023 */
024public interface ModuleLoadingPostProcessor {
025  /**
026   * Post-processes the provided Metaschema module.
027   *
028   * @param module
029   *          the Module module to generate classes for
030   * @param bindingContext
031   *          the Metaschema binding context used to load bound resources
032   * @since 2.0.0
033   */
034  void postProcessModule(
035      @NonNull IModule module,
036      @NonNull IBindingContext bindingContext);
037}
